evals.prompt: Draft a PRD for a saved-search feature in our analytics product — users keep re-running the same filters every morning.
assertions: The problem statement contains zero solution language and passes the alternative-solution test — more than one solution could follow from it
Every requirement is verifiable — a tester can demo it pass or fail; adjective requirements and implementation choices are rejected
The won't-have list is non-empty and names specific excluded things
Each goal carries a success line stating how it will be measured
Claims that need evidence are marked rather than asserted as fact
